b3e459a2-0103-4182-8882-c255d474a7ff.description: Tax policy analysts research and develop taxation policies and legislation in order to improve and develop tax policies. They advise official bodies on policy implementation and financial operations, as well as forecast financial influence of changes in tax policies.

61ed67cd-67d7-44d8-bc2d-47fc79110a59.title: taxi controller
61ed67cd-67d7-44d8-bc2d-47fc79110a59.description: Taxi controllers take bookings, dispatch vehicles, and are responsible for coordinating drivers while maintaining customer liaison.

6f7c1e84-8162-4c20-a575-b57ff624eef5.description: Taxi drivers operate a licensed private passenger transportation vehicle, looking after customers, taking fares and managing vehicle servicing.

a78d8e2b-fe31-447f-8694-38ed7198d143.description: Taxidermists mount and reproduce deceased animals or parts of animals such as trofy heads for the purpose of public display and education, such as in a museum or monument, or for other sources of scientific study, or for a private collection.

1044dedc-81d1-48b6-96b3-ced5393b2de1.description: Talented and gifted students co-ordinators ensure suitable education is provided to talented and gifted students, commonly children and young adults, on various levels. c5d36eef-df20-47a8-a332-5b4358fa83e3.description: Telecommunications analysts review, analyse and evaluate an organisation's telecommunications needs and systems. They provide training on the telecommunications system features and functionalities.

02eb0ae6-ecdd-4602-9c8e-60ffe6dbe1e2.title: telecommunications engineer
02eb0ae6-ecdd-4602-9c8e-60ffe6dbe1e2.description:
Telecommunications engineers design, build, test and maintain telecommunication systems and networks, including radio and broadcasting equipment. \
They analyse customer needs and requirements, ensure that the equipment meets regulations, and prepare and present reports and proposals on telecommunication-related problems. Telecommunications engineers design and oversee the service delivery in all it's phases, supervising the installation and use of telecommunications equipment and facilities, preparing documentation and providing training for company staff once new equipment has been installed.

d84bf1d7-ef99-40c4-a407-3791d6531b44.title: telecommunications engineering technician
d84bf1d7-ef99-40c4-a407-3791d6531b44.description: Telecommunications engineering technician deploy, maintain and monitor a telecommunication system that provides interactions between data and voice communications, such as telephone, video conferencing, computer, and voicemail systems. They are also involved in the design, manufacturing, construction, maintenance and repair of telecommunication systems. Telecommunications engineering technicians provide technical assistance in the research and development of telecommunication equipment.

d07e6a57-a339-4cfd-bf22-a951713148a3.title: telecommunications equipment maintainer
d07e6a57-a339-4cfd-bf22-a951713148a3.description: Telecommunications equipment maintainers repair, install or maintain mobile or stationary radio transmitting, broadcasting, and receiving equipment, and two-way radio communications systems (cellular telecommunications, mobile broadband, ship-to-shore, aircraft-to-ground communications, radio equipment in service and emergency vehicles). They also focus on communication towers, antennas, amplifiers and connectors. They may test and analyse network coverage.

f4b4fb1d-0224-4e6b-b7c9-84bcf133be00.title: telecommunications equipment specialised seller
f4b4fb1d-0224-4e6b-b7c9-84bcf133be00.description: Telecommunications equipment specialised sellers sell telecommunication equipment and services in specialised shops.
alt: mobile devices and accessories specialised seller

3ce4691e-ecea-4278-939e-b89ab01087b8.title: telecommunications manager
3ce4691e-ecea-4278-939e-b89ab01087b8.description: Telecommunications managers coordinate telecommunications staff activities for installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining telecommunications equipment and infrastructure. They oversee the research, evaluation and implementation of new technologies and ensure a safe working environment for the employees. They supervise the inventory of supplies as well as user and customer assistance actions.

056bef79-c125-47ab-b6b9-8eed05c9458c.title: telecommunications technician
056bef79-c125-47ab-b6b9-8eed05c9458c.description: Telecommunications technicians install, test, maintain and troubleshoot telecommunications systems. They repair or replace defective devices and equipment and maintain a safe working environment and a complete inventory of supplies. They also provide user or customer assistance.

0bf68df5-e808-4c27-abf2-6f85440f2d7f.title: telephone switchboard operator
0bf68df5-e808-4c27-abf2-6f85440f2d7f.description: Telephone switchboard operators establish telephone connections by using switchboards and consoles. They also answer customer inquiries and service problem reports.

b3086ad2-1f3c-4a60-9bdb-8b4746989d4b.title: tennis coach
b3086ad2-1f3c-4a60-9bdb-8b4746989d4b.description: Tennis coaches advise and guide individuals and groups on playing tennis. They conduct lessons and teach the rules and techniques of the sport such as grips, strokes and serves. They motivate their clients and help improve their performance.

8c778238-98a4-4fec-a828-a4e978fb7a64.title: tent installer
8c778238-98a4-4fec-a828-a4e978fb7a64.description: Tent installers set up and dismantle temporary shelters, tents and circus tents with the associated accommodation for events and performances. Their work is based on instruction, plans and calculations. They work mostly outdoors and can be assisted by local crew.

a50d64e7-2dba-4418-81a7-92b2ba2e508f.title: terrazzo setter
a50d64e7-2dba-4418-81a7-92b2ba2e508f.description: Terrazzo setters create terrazzo surfaces. They prepare the surface, installing strips to divide sections. They then pour the solution containing cement and marble chips. Terrazzo setters finish the floor by polishing the surface to ensure smoothness and shine.

8249697a-3dc8-417d-9acf-3a7e0864069a.title: terrazzo setter supervisor
8249697a-3dc8-417d-9acf-3a7e0864069a.description: Terrazzo setter supervisors monitor terrazzo setting operations. They assign tasks and take quick decision to resolve problems.

c8fa93eb-7c2c-42c3-b135-c2e825a6615e.title: test engineer
c8fa93eb-7c2c-42c3-b135-c2e825a6615e.description: Test engineers plan and perform detailed quality tests during various phases of the design process to make sure that the systems are properly installed and function correctly. They analyse the data collected during tests and produce reports. They are also responsible for the safety of the test operations.

16bc69b8-5abc-49e4-a860-befb734d54d3.title: textile chemical quality technician
16bc69b8-5abc-49e4-a860-befb734d54d3.description: Textile chemical quality technicians perform chemical laboratory tests on textile materials and products. They interpret results and support colouration and finishing of textiles.

55076d82-52a7-47eb-b882-f12322c42ecd.title: textile chemist
55076d82-52a7-47eb-b882-f12322c42ecd.description: Textile chemists coordinate and supervise chemical processes for textiles like yarn and fabric forming such as dyeing and finishing.

6d765c21-267d-4d3d-a989-9b7596670477.title: textile colourist
6d765c21-267d-4d3d-a989-9b7596670477.description: Textile colourists prepare, develop and create colours for textile applications.

0f7c84c5-1c0d-4fc1-8949-07dbe8bd34ef.description: Textile designers conceptualise textile products considering visual communication and functional performance.

2229a024-21e4-43ef-b3fd-2444ab41bfb8.description: Textile dyeing technicians perform operations related to setting up dyeing processes.

884beda8-d242-4fc3-a097-dc11098a7c3d.description: Textile dyers tend dye machines making sure that the setting of machines are in place. They prepare chemicals, dyes, dye baths and solutions according to formulas. They make samples by dyeing textiles and calculating the necessary formulas and dyes all kind of yarn or and textiles.

2aa7fbbb-f06e-4454-8ff8-2d799e86ba51.description: Textile machinery technicians set up, maintain, inspect and repair mechanical and computer-controlled machinery used in textile manufacturing such as weaving, dyeing and finishing machines.

518348e6-0095-4f37-ad46-5ef1b8b5ee2f.description: Textile operations managers schedule orders and delivery times in order to assure the efficient flow of the production system.

0a9eb24a-13e7-4847-8f6e-a776771ac96b.title: textile pattern making machine operator
0a9eb24a-13e7-4847-8f6e-a776771ac96b.description: Textile pattern making machine operators create patterns, designs and decoration for textiles and fabrics using machines and equipment. They choose which materials to use and check the quality of the textiles both before and after their work.

5b942a51-c9a2-4dc7-82cc-57451426cf4d.description: Textile printers perform textile printing operations.

745c8bb3-b50b-4380-9377-1b68a6576986.description: Textile process controllers perform textile process operations, technical functions in various aspects of design, production and quality control of textile products, and cost control for processes. They use computer aided manufacturing (CAM), and computer integrated manufacturing (CIM) tools in order to ensure conformity of entire production process to specifications. They compare and exchange individual processes with other departments (e.g cost calculation office) and initiate appropriate actions. They analyse the structure and properties of raw materials used in textiles and assist to prepare specifications for their production, analyse and interpret test data.

6833077e-e521-4605-bc1a-893f4b3d811c.title: textile product developer
6833077e-e521-4605-bc1a-893f4b3d811c.description: Textile product developers innovate and perform product design of apparel textiles, home textiles, and technical textiles (e.g. agriculture, safety, construction, medicine, mobile tech, environmental protection, sports, etc.). They apply scientific and technical principles to develop innovative textile products.

85fdd1cb-98d3-4c40-a868-1078ce770440.title: textile quality inspector
85fdd1cb-98d3-4c40-a868-1078ce770440.description: Textile quality inspectors ensure that the manufactured of textile products is compliant with predetermined specifications.

652b847f-837a-4a08-bd5e-36397fe56455.title: textile quality manager
652b847f-837a-4a08-bd5e-36397fe56455.description: Textile quality managers implement, manage and promote quality systems. They make sure that the textile products adheres to the quality standards of the organisation. Textile quality managers therefore inspect textile production lines and products.

0663da10-e42c-41e8-992c-07d00ac97bea.title: textile quality technician
0663da10-e42c-41e8-992c-07d00ac97bea.description: Textile quality technicians perform physical laboratory tests on textile materials and products. They compare textile materials and products to standards and interpret results.

9beeb1f0-5aca-4bde-bae9-c74ddb94fac3.description: Textile shop managers assume responsibility for activities and staff in specialised shops.

70182f44-e444-4bf3-940f-0c054c1d5917.description: Textile, leather and footwear researchers combine knowledge of material sciences, chemistry, physics, process technologies, management, and engineering to contribute to future innovations within the fields of textile, wearing apparel, leather, and footwear. a9e54177-a185-404d-b6e6-15663d31137e.description: Therapeutic radiographers prepare and perform safe and accurate high-energy radiation treatments to patients, using a wide range of sophisticated equipment and techniques, to target the area to be treated, and computer planning to produce a plan of the dose distribution across the area to be treated.

afbe50b0-6634-4677-a3e7-0aada10cb9a7.title: thermal engineer
afbe50b0-6634-4677-a3e7-0aada10cb9a7.description: Thermal engineers design systems which provide heating or cooling, using thermodynamics, that transfer heat or energy through liquids and gases. They also construct these systems, and perform test to ensure proper functionality.

77a25ee0-94ad-443e-91ea-3e6d3506181b.title: thread rolling machine operator
77a25ee0-94ad-443e-91ea-3e6d3506181b.description: Thread rolling machine operators set up and tend thread rolling machines designed to form metal workpieces into external and internal screw threads by pressing a thread rolling die against metal blank rods, creating a larger diameter than those of the original blank workpieces.

612430b3-dd43-4786-b823-0466c4953f66.title: ticket issuing clerk
612430b3-dd43-4786-b823-0466c4953f66.description: Ticket issuing clerks provide service to customers, sell tickets and fit the reservation offer to customers' needs. bdf2dd9d-6c92-46f4-a8e7-76c12302d3e7.description: Ticket sales agents provide initial service to customers, sell travel tickets and fit the reservation offer to customers' queries and needs.

02447817-ea01-4d8b-b09c-8bc128e447e6.description: Tile fitters install tiles onto walls and floors. They cut tiles to the right size and shape, prepare the surface, and put the tiles in place flush and straight. Tile fitters may also take on creative and artistic projects, with some laying mosaics.

18cff178-4ef0-46c9-a6e5-f6f38179cdcb.title: tiling supervisor
18cff178-4ef0-46c9-a6e5-f6f38179cdcb.description: Tiling supervisors monitor tile fitting operations. They assign tasks and take quick decisions to resolve problems.

0ab77768-9031-4ccc-9ab8-1f73cbb36bc7.description: Tissue paper perforating and rewinding operators tend a machine that takes in tissue paper, perforates it, and rolls it up to create various types of sanitary paper.
